verdict.rationale: Sumsub's AML screening explicitly screens against "constantly changing sanctions lists, PEP lists and data, watchlists, and adverse media" and webhooks notify on applicant verification changes, suggesting some ongoing monitoring and event-based alerting. However, there is no explicit documentation of automatic re-screening of already-approved applicants against watchlist updates or a dedicated webhook/event type for watchlist-match changes post-verification. Missing for 10: explicit continuous/ongoing monitoring workflow for previously verified users, specific event/webhook type for watchlist-hit changes, and any hands-on confirmation of this re-screening loop.
